title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Java
description:
Senior Java Developer Location: SMILES 8-Madurai-Madurai Years of Experience: 3-4 Years Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in developing RESTful APIs, working with SQL/JPA, and utilizing Angular/TypeScript for front-end development. This role requires a deep understanding of software testing, security best practices, and cloud technologies. The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable systems while ensuring high performance and responsiveness. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain robust Java applications using Spring Boot. Implement RESTful APIs for seamless integration with front-end applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. Utilize SQL/JPA for database management and data manipulation. Develop and maintain front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript. Ensure the security of applications by implementing best practices and conducting regular security assessments. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members. Utilize Docker and CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment and continuous integration. Design and implement microservices architecture to enhance system scalability and maintainability. Contribute to system design discussions and provide innovative solutions to complex problems. Mandatory Skills: Proficient in Java (Deal Breaker Skill). Strong experience with Spring Boot framework. Solid understanding of SQL and JPA for database interactions. Experience in developing REST APIs. Familiarity with Angular and TypeScript for front-end development. Knowledge of software testing methodologies and tools. Understanding of security best practices in software development. Experience with microservices architecture. Proficient in using Docker and CI/CD tools. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.). Preferred Skills: Experience with Agile methodologies. Familiarity with DevOps practices. Knowledge of additional programming languages. Experience with performance tuning and optimization. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5-8 years of professional experience in software development. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Key Skills: SQL,Bootstrap,JPA,Typescript,Integration,Senior,Microsoft,Rest

title: PHP Developer| Sr. PHP Developer | PHP Programmer|
description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client for a remote PHP Laravel Backend Developer position. This opportunity is ideal for candidates based in India who can align their work schedule with US Central Time (CST) business hours. 
Role Overview
Position: PHP Laravel Backend Developer
Location: Remote (India-based)
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM 1:00 PM CST
IST Equivalent: 6:30 PM 11:30 PM I ... ST
Probation Period: 3 to 6 months 
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Laravel
Write clean, reusable, and testable PHP code
Optimize application security, performance, and database queries
Integrate APIs and collaborate with front-end developers
Participate in agile ceremonies and follow code review standards
Requirements:
25 years of hands-on PHP development experience (Laravel mandatory)
Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and RESTful APIs
Experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL
Familiarity with Git version control
Strong debugging and analytical skills
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field (preferred)
Working Schedule & Policies 
Work Hours:
Monday to Friday, aligned with US Central Time (CST) business hours
Indian candidates will work evening shifts to ensure time zone overlap 
Breaks:
Short scheduled breaks will be provided during the shift for rest and refreshment
Leave Policy:
Leaves must be planned and communicated at least 7 days in advance
Uninformed or last-minute absences may result in salary deductions
Regular attendance and communication are expected for continued engagement
